people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
translations.bsb: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
translations.kjv: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
translations.asv: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; because he was content to walk after mans' command.
